_comment: Heuristic knowledge base. Not real ATS vendor data. Review and extend.

top_product.name: Top Product
top_product.description: Tier 1 product engineering bars requiring deep algorithmic problem solving, high-scale system architecture, and rigorous metrics.
top_product.projectExpectation: 2+ substantial production-scale or distributed projects, notable open source contributions, or prestigious engineering internships.
keyBonusSignals: Strong DSA fundamentals and competitive programming / LeetCode track record
Experience handling scale (millions of users, QPS, latency optimizations in ms, TBs of data)
Deep understanding of distributed systems internals, concurrency, and memory management
Tier-1 tech internships or contributions to recognized open source repositories
keyRisks: Descriptive task lists without measurable business or scale impact metrics
Missing fundamental CS foundations (OOP, DSA, OS, networking)
Only trivial CRUD/tutorial tutorial clones without original architectural complexity
Less than 60% of experience bullets having quantifiable results

startup_unicorn.name: Startup / Unicorn
startup_unicorn.description: High-velocity high-ownership environments valuing shipping velocity, end-to-end full-stack range, and direct product impact.
startup_unicorn.projectExpectation: Shipped and live deployed web/mobile products with active users, end-to-end full-stack ownership, and production monitoring.
keyBonusSignals: Demonstrated end-to-end product ownership from 0 to 1 and rapid iteration
Live deployed application links, published packages, or production URLs in resume
Direct business outcomes (revenue lifted, CAC reduced, conversion improved, cost saved)
Pragmatic full-stack range across client, server, and cloud deployment
keyRisks: Over-specialization in narrow legacy stacks without modern framework agility
No evidence of shipping independently or working with ambiguity
Lack of public artifacts or live demo links for major projects
Bullets framed around theoretical processes rather than shipping actual user-facing features

service_mnc.name: Service / MNC
service_mnc.description: Enterprise consulting and client delivery organizations emphasizing strong fundamentals, disciplined SDLC, and certified competency.
service_mnc.projectExpectation: Clearly documented enterprise client projects, standard SDLC processes, database schema management, and client deliverables.
keyBonusSignals: Solid core language skills (Java, Python, C#, SQL, JavaScript) and DBMS mastery
Clear academic scores, CGPA/percentage, and recognized degree credentials
Industry certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Oracle Java, Microsoft Azure)
Structured project documentation following Agile/Scrum delivery processes
keyRisks: Non-standard unconventional resume layout failing automated enterprise parser scans
Missing clear dates, educational credentials, or location details
Unverified skill claims unsupported by designated project work
Spelling or grammatical errors indicating low attention to detail in client-facing work
